Do you feel like you've lost a part of yourself while trying to keep someone else happy? If so, you may have experienced narcissistic abuse. Unlike physical abuse, narcissistic abuse often leaves invisible wounds. It can deeply affect a person's confidence, emotional wellbeing, relationships, and sense of identity. The good news is that recovery is possible. With awareness, support, and healing, you can rebuild your life and rediscover your authentic self. What Is Narcissistic Abuse? For millions of people, this is not imagination—it is reality. While awareness about mental health has increased significantly in recent years, access to quality mental health support remains a challenge for many individuals. Financial barriers, social stigma, lack of resources, and limited awareness continue to prevent people from receiving the care they deserve. At Shambhave Wellness Foundation, we firmly believe that mental health is not a luxury reserved for a few. It is a basic human right that should be accessible to everyone, regardless of age, gender, social status, or financial circumstances.
